cros_ec_hardrec_pbinitidle_power: force power on after power_state:reset Certain boards (Fizz and derivatives) will retain their state even after a power_state:reset call. For example, if the DUT is off prior to power_state:reset, it will remain off after the call. However, autotest does not expect this and expects the DUT to be online after the power_state:reset call. Creating a new cros_ec_hardrec_pbinitidle_power driver that inherits from cros_ec_hardrec_power that is only used for Fizz at the moment in order to minimize interference with other boards. scarlet: add SKU identification for Wacom firmware Wacom EMR panels don't have a power-cut tolerant ID, so we can't reliably support different firmware for different SKUs via any of their discovery mechanisms. On scarlet, we have an existing SKU strapping within the panel flex cable, such that we can indirectly identify the Wacom panel too. This was plumbed into the machine compatible property (e.g., "google,gru-scarlet-rev5-sku6") and was recently plumbed into 'mosys' (CL:1028759 and CL:1028728). If we can't identify the SKU, assume that we're running SKU7, since the initial RO firmware (on SKU7) didn't support the device tree property (/proc/device-tree/firmware/coreboot/sku-id). If we don't have appropriate /lib/firmware/wacom2_*.hex symlinks, the updater falls back cleanly to just using /lib/firmware/wacom_firmware.hex. I don't think Wacom has provided any meaningful distinction between the product IDs on our two SKUs, so I just make up something that's obviously not a product ID ("sku6" and "sku7"). An example setup for firmware placement: # ls -l /lib/firmware/wacom2_firmware_* lrwxrwxrwx. 1 root root 40 Apr 26 10:37 /lib/firmware/wacom2_firmware_sku6.hex -> /opt/google/touch/firmware/sku6_4948.hex lrwxrwxrwx. 1 root root 40 Apr 26 10:37 /lib/firmware/wacom2_firmware_sku7.hex -> /opt/google/touch/firmware/sku7_4947.hex BUG=b:73506715 TEST=/opt/google/touch/scripts/chromeos-touch-update.sh with and without wacom2_*.hex binaries Change-Id: I9cddcb9302088c1bc92b45d37625cab7fd3747a9 Signed-off-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1028986 Reviewed-by: Simon Glass <sjg@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Philip Chen <philipchen@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Julius Werner <jwerner@chromium.org>
